sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 48.9.2 "MTL initialization" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2235.
sections.section_content:
Complete the following steps to initialize the MTL registers:
1. Program the following fields to initialize the operating mode in Tx queue 0 operating
mode register (ETH_MTLTXQ0OMR).
a) Transmit store and forward (TSF) or transmit threshold control (TTC) if the
Threshold mode is used.
2. Program the following fields to initialize the operating mode in the
ETH_MTLRXQ0OMR register (see Rx queue 0 operating mode register
(ETH_MTLRXQ0OMR)):
a) Receive store and forward (RSF) or RTC if Threshold mode is used.
b) Flow control activation and deactivation thresholds for MTL Receive FIFO (RFA
and RFD).
c) Error packet and undersized good packet forwarding enable (FEP and FUP).
d) Receive queue size (RQS).
